items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Some of the musicians have implied, if not stated outright, that—I think Ben Webster did—that [when] you joined the band, you became musical director of Willy Bryant’s band.

ctx.x: Some of the musicians have implied, if not stated outright, that—I think Ben Webster did—that [when] you joined the band, you became musical director of Willy Bryant’s band. Was that . . .

I may have. It was a very short stint, but Willy Bryant was not a musician. He didn’t play an instrument. He didn’t read music. He sang a little. So there had to be somebody giving him some musical guidance. It might have been me, I don’t know.
